Seven comments

This tune was composed by Dan R. Macdonald.

↳ Posted by SPeak on October 24th, 2002.

The trip to windsor

This tune can be hear played by 8 or 9 fiddlers on a CD called “Traditional Music from Cape Breton Island”. Natalie, Buddy, John Morris, Howie, and many more play on this compilation. Something else the tunes you hear… awesome!

↳ Posted by ktmacm on April 30th, 2003.

“This tune was composed by Dan R. Macdonald”
Very right. It is therefore a Cape Breton tune.
